_comment: Per-clash deployment distance demo: the script's deployment_gap_m (60 m) is the same Battle.deployment_gap_m a campaign clash sets from its defended province's data, applied through BattleMap.with_line_gap. Team 0's line stays at y=300, team 1's line moves to y=1500 (1200 wu = 60 m below it, against the default 580 wu / 29 m), and the field grows downward to 1820 so the defenders keep their 320 wu of ground behind the line. Both armies therefore open BEYOND the 600-wu demote range: they start in the far tier (grid marks, no soldier bodies) and promote back to individual soldiers once the lines have closed inside 400 wu. Default 5v5 loadout, its own seed; the whole player line is box-selected and marched at the enemy while the enemy AI advances to meet it, so the clip shows the wide opening, the far-tier march, the promotion, and the clash.
